title: Test sends reach only the server list, are ledgered before one Gmail call, and an unanswered send is reconciled, never resent
steps: Run the send ledger, config fence and mounted UI suites from this branch against a private PostgreSQL (TEST_DATABASE_URL), with the fake Google in the test that counts every messages.send.
expect: An approved draft sent to a listed address makes exactly one messages.send; the same requestKey returns the first row with no second call; another payload under it answers REAL_REQUEST_KEY_REUSED.
Off, an unlisted address, a stale or unapproved draft, a disconnected mailbox and a reached cap are refused before any call.
A send with no answer is send_unknown; reconcile with no match keeps it unknown; one match makes it sent; the send count stays one.
A row left in sending while the mailbox lock is free becomes send_unknown with no call; two concurrent sends give one REAL_SEND_BUSY.
INVITATIONS_SENDING=test reads as off on staging and production and without a list.
Review content offers only the server list and posts one send per press with the current draft revision.
fence: Fake Google only; no credential, no real mailbox, no customer address. Private PostgreSQL and a temporary key vault.

tests: the message is UTF-8 safe, carries managed images inline and refuses header injection
a test send goes to an allowed address once, is ledgered before the call, and a repeat changes nothing
only the server-held list, only approved drafts, only a usable mailbox, only within the daily cap
no answer means unknown, never a second send; reconcile by Message-ID settles it
a refusal is failed and frees the cap; a row a stopped process left in sending becomes unknown
two sends at once: one holds the mailbox, the other is told to wait and sends nothing
over HTTP: the doors exist for owners only, sending reads off by default, and no customer door opens
test sending opens only where real campaigns run, only with a list, and never on staging or production
Send a test lists only the server test addresses and sends the approved email once per press
